name: Sneezing
arabic: ((إِذَا عَطَسَ أَحَدُكُم فَلْيَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلْيَقُلْ لَهُ أَخُوهُ أَوْ صَاحِبُهُ: يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ، فَإِذَا قَالَ لَهُ: يَرحَمُكَ اللَّهُ، فَلْيَقُلْ: يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ)).

translations.albanian: Falënderimi i qoftë Allahut.\nAllahu të Mëshiroftë.\nAllahu ju udhëzoftë dhe ua përmirësoftë gjendjen tuaj.
translations.english: (When one of you sneezes he should say:(All praise if for Allah.) and his brother or companion should say to him: (May Allah have mercy upon you.) and he (i.e. the one who sneezed) replies back to him:(May Allah guide you and rectify your condition.))
translations.indonesian: Segala puji bagi Allah yang memberi makan ini kepadaku dan yang memberi rezeki kepadaku tanpa daya dan kekuatanku.
